mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.5%, signaling aggressive monetary tightening, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 5.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market with rising wages boosts consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening supply periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $400 billion, indicating high retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Nov-Dec).
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered holiday season instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 4% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2%), a dovish monetary stance with tame inflation expectations reduces discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp 1-month increase in UNRATE (> 0.5pp), indicating labor market softening, leads to reduced consumer spending expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, HOUST serves as a leading indicator for economic demand; when it exceeds 1600 (thousands of units), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days, driven by anticipated housing market growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 58% of instances with HOUST above 1600, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.
